system.flavor:
Call two people to a spot and put the fight back in them: the wagon, the gate, the far side of the ford. Rattled porters get back to lifting, nervous recruits stop looking over their shoulder.

Not enough to rally a whole crew or make anyone brave past the moment.

body.label: Target
body.html: One visible space within 3 units; willing creatures within 1 unit of it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Choose up to two targets, including yourself if in range. Each becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn. Mark the space as your rally point for that duration.

surges.html: One target may move 1 unit toward the point.
Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 while adjacent to the point until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Standard
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a willing creature reaches the marked point before your next turn: it may suppress one ordinary Success Die penalty on its next Combat Card.
